payload.title: Content-Security-Policy is limited to frame-ancestors for now
payload.context: Security review of M3 (#16) added security response headers.
payload.rationale: A full script and style policy needs nonce support in the Vite build. frame-ancestors none with X-Frame-Options DENY closes clickjacking today without breaking the app.
payload.consequences: A full policy is left for M7 hardening.
